English: They treated their soil samples with the activated carbon to see if it would reduce the amount of metals in the soil.
Luganda: Baalongoosa sampolo z’ettaka lyabwe nga bakozesa kaboni omulamu okulaba nga asobola okukendeeza obungi bw’ebyuma ebiri mu ttaka.
Yoruba: Wọ̀n ṣétọ́jú fún àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ilẹ̀ wọn pẹ̀lú kábọ́ọ̀nì ìkẹ́gbin láti ri bóyá ó máa dín iye àwọn irin kù nínú ilẹ̀.
Zulu: Baphatha amasampula abo omhlaba ngekhabhoni ecushiwe ukuze babone ukuthi izokwehlisa yini inani lezinsimbi emhlabathini.
Hausa: Sun saka wa samfuran ƙasarsu gawayi da aka kunna don ganin ko zai rage adadin ƙarafa a cikin ƙasar.
Northern Sotho: Ba hlwekišitše disampole tša mabu ka khapone ye ekthibeitilwego go bona ge e ba e ka fokotša kelo ya dimetale ka mabung.
Amharic: በአፈሩ ውስጥ ያሉትን ብረቶች መጠን ይቀንስ እንደሆን ለማየት የአፈር ናሙናቸውን በነቃው ካርቦን አክመው ነበር፡፡

English: The researchers said that in the untreated soil samples, the amount of metals present were higher than what is considered safe by the World Health Organization (WHO).
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti mu ttaka eryali terinnalongoosebwa, obungi bw’ebyuma ebyalimu bwali waggulu ddala okusinga ku obwo obutwalibwa Ekitongole kya World Health Organization (WHO) obutaba bwa bulabe.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ní nínú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ilẹ̀ tí wọn ò tíì tọ́jú, iye irin tó wà níbẹ̀ ju èyí tí Àjọ Ìlẹra Àgbáyé (WHO) wò pé kò léwu.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe emasampula omhlabathi angakahlanzwa, inani lezinsimbi ezikhona lingaphezulu kwalelo elithathwa njengephephile yinhlangano yezempilo emhlabeni wonke iWorld Health Organisation (WHO).
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce a cikin samfuran ƙasa da ba a kula da su ba, adadin ƙarafa da ke wurin ya zarce abin da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta yi la’akari da shi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore go disampole tša mabu ao a sa hlwekišwago, kelo ya dimetale tše di lego gona e be e le godimo go feta tšeo di bonwago di bolokegile go ya ka Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase (WHO).
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ባልታከሙት የአፈር ናሙናዎች ውስጥ የነበረው የብረቶች መጠን በአለም ጤና ድርጅት (አ.ጤ.ድ) ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ነው ተብሎ ከሚጠበቀው መጠን ከፍ ያለ ነበር፡፡

English: WHO is an organisation that sets regulations related to health for the whole world.
Luganda: WHO kitongole ekiteekawo ebigobererwa ebyekwanya ku byobulamu mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: WHO jẹ́ ìgbìnmọ̀ tó ń fi òfin lélẹ̀ lórí àwon ohun tó jẹ mọ́ ìlera fún gbogbo àgbáyé.
Zulu: I-WHO yinhlangano ebeka imithethonqubo ehlobene nempilo yomhlaba wonke.
Hausa: WHO ƙungiya ce da take tsara dokoki da suka shafi kiwon lafiya ga duk duniya.
Northern Sotho: WHO ke mokgatlo wo o beago melao ye e amanago le tša maphelo lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: አ.ጤ.ድ ለመላው አለም ከጤና ጋር የተያያዙ ደንቦችን የሚያወጣው ድርጅት ነው፡፡

English: A possible reason for these elevated levels of metals is that people burn computers, refrigerators, cables, batteries and other e-waste, causing the metals in these electronics to leak out into the soil.
Luganda: Ensonga eyinza okunnyonnyola obungi bw’ebyuma ebyo obususse eri nti abantu bookya kompyuta, fiiriigi, waya, amanda ne kasasiro kinnamasannyalaze omulala, ne kireetera ebyuma ebiri mu bintu ebyo eby’amasannyalaze okusaanuuka ne biyingira mu ttaka.
Yoruba: Ohun tó lè jẹ́ ìdí fún gíga ìpele àwọn irin yìí ni àwọn èèyàn tí wọ́n ń sun àwọn ẹ̀rọ ayárabíàṣá, fírìgì, kábù, bátìrì àti àwọn ìdọ̀tí-ẹ̀rọ ,míràn, èyí tó ń fa ki àwọn irin inú àwọn ẹ̀rọ yìí jò wọnú ilẹ̀.
Zulu: Isizathu esingaba yisizathu salezi zinsimbi eziphakeme ukuthi abantu bashisa amakhompiyutha, iziqandisi, izintambo, amabhethri nokunye okulahlwa yi-e, okwenza izinsimbi ezikula ma-electronics zivuze emhlabathini.
Hausa: Wani dalili da zai iya haifar da waɗannan matakan haɓakar ƙarafa shi ne yadda mutane suke ƙone kwamfutoci da firij da igiyoyi da batura da sauran sharar lantarki, wanda hakan ya sa ƙarafunan da suke cikin waɗannan na’urorin lantarki suke zubowa cikin ƙasar.
Northern Sotho: Lebaka le le kgonagalago la dikelo tše tše di hlatlogilego tša dimetale ke gore batho ba fiša dikhomphutha, ditšidifatši, dikheipole, dipeteri le ditlakala tše dingwe tša elektroniki, ba baka gore dimetale ka gare ga dielektroniki tše di falalele mabung.
Amharic: ለእነዚህ ከፍተኛ የብረቶች መጠን ምክንያት ሊሆን የሚችለው ሰዎች እነዚህን ኤሌክትሮኒክሶች ወደ አፈሩ እንዲገቡ የሚያደርጓቸውን ኮምፒውተሮች፣ ፍሪጆች፣ ኬብሎች፣ ባትሪዎች እና ሌሎች ኢ-ቆሻሻዎችን ስለሚያቃጥሉ ነው፡፡

English: Copper levels were the highest, followed by lead, chromium, iron and cadmium.
Luganda: Ekigero kya kkopa kye kyali kisinga obungi, ne kuddako liidi, chromium, ayani ne cadmium.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìpele kọ́pà ló ga jù, lẹ́yìn náà ni lẹ́ẹ̀dì, kírómíọ̀mù, áyọ̀nù àti kádímíọ̀mù.
Zulu: Amazinga ethusi ayephezulu kakhulu, alandelwa umthofu, i-chromium, insimbi ne-cadmium.
Hausa: Matakan jan ƙarfe sun kasance mafi girma, sai dalma da sinadarin hana tsatsa da baƙin ƙarfe da kuma cadmium.
Northern Sotho: Dikelo tša koporo di bile godimodimo, tša latelwa ke lead, khromiamo, tšhipi le khatemiamo.
Amharic: ሌድ፣ ክሮሚየም፣ አይረን እና ካድሚየምን በማስከተል ከሁሉም እጅግ ከፍተኛ መጠን የነበረው መዳብ ነበር፡፤

English: The researchers said that the activated carbon they created by burning the cashew nut shells was indeed able to soak up some of these metal pollutants.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti kaboni omulamu gwe baakola nga bookya ebisusunku bya cashew nuts ddala yasobozesa okunuuna ebimu ku byuma ebicaafuwaza.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ní kábọ́ọ̀nì ìkẹ́gbin tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀dá látàrí sísun àwọn ìkaraun èso kaṣú ṣiṣẹ́ fún ìkónílẹ̀ díẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìdọ̀tí irin yìí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ikhabhoni ecushiwe abayenza ngokushisa amagobolondo e-cashew nut yakwazi ngempela ukucwilisa ezinye zalezi zinto ezingcolisa insimbi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayyana cewa, gawayi da aka kunna da suka ƙirƙira ta hanyar ƙona kwanson ƙwallon kashu haƙiƙa yana iya jiƙa wasu daga cikin waɗannan gurbatattun ƙarafa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore khapone ye ekthibeitilwego yeo ba e hlamilego ka go fiša makgapetla a ditloo tša cashew ka nnete e tloga e kgonne go moma tše dingwe tša ditšhilafatši tše tša metale.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት የኬጁ ፍሬ ገለባዎችን በማቃጠል የፈጠሩት የነቃ ካርቦን በእርግጥም አንዳንዶቹን የብረት መራዦች መጥጦ ማውጣት ችሎ ነበር፡፡

English: For example, after treatment, the soil was completely free of cadmium.
Luganda: Okugeza, oluvannyuma lw’okulongoosa ettaka, ekyuma kya cadmium kyaggweeramu ddala.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹẹrẹ, lẹ́yìn ìtọ́jú, ilẹ̀ náà ò ní kádímíọ̀mù kankan mọ́.
Zulu: Ngokwesibonelo, ngemva kokwelashwa, inhlabathi yayingenayo i-cadmium ngokuphelele.
Hausa: Alal misali, bayan jiyya, ƙasa ba ta da cikakken cadmium.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, morago ga tlhwekišo, mabu a be a se na khatemiamo le gatee.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ከህክምና በኋላ አፈሩ ሙሉ በሙሉ ከካድሚየም ነጻ ነበር፡፡

English: So, the burnt cashew nut shells were most effective at cleaning up cadmium, followed by lead, iron, copper and chromium.
Luganda: Kale nno, cashew nut eyayokebwa yasinga kukola mu kulongoosaamu cadmium, ne kuddako liidi, ayani, koppa ne chromium.
Yoruba: Nítorí náà, ìkaraun kóró èso kaṣú tó di súnsun ṣiṣẹ́ jù fún fífọ kádímíọ̀mù jù, lẹ́yìn náà ní lẹ́ẹ̀dì, áyọ̀nù, kọ́pà àti kírómíọ̀mù.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke, amagobolondo e-cashew nut ashisiwe ayesebenza kakhulu ekuhlanzeni i-cadmium, elandelwa umthofu, insimbi, ithusi ne-chromium.
Hausa: Don haka, ƙonannun kwanson ƙwallon kashi sun fi tasiri wajen tsaftace cadmium, sannan da dalma da baƙin ƙarfe da jan karfe da kuma sinadarin hana tsatsa.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona, makgapetla a ditloo tša cashew tše di fišitšwego di bile le mohola o mogolo go tlhwekišo ya khatemiamo, gwa latela lead, tšhipi, koporo le khromiamo.
Amharic: ስለዚህ የተቃጠሉት የኬጁ ፍሬ ገለባዎች ካድሚየምን ለማጽዳት እጅግ ውጤታማ ነበሩ፡ ከዛ ደግሞ ሌድ፣ አይረን፣ መዳብ እና ክሮሚየም ይከተላሉ፡፡

English: Overall, a powdered version of the activated carbon cleaned the soil better than a granulated version.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, kaboni omulamu ow’obuwunga yalongoosa ettaka mu ngeri esingako okusinga oyo awa bulijjo.
Yoruba: Ní àkótán, ẹlẹ́bu kábọ́ọ̀nì ìkẹ́gbin dára láti sàfọ̀mọ́ ilẹ̀ ju oníwóró kékèké lọ.
Zulu: Sekukonke, inguqulo eyimpuphu yekhabhoni ecushiwe yahlanza inhlabathi kangcono kunenguqulo eyicwecwe.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, nau’in hoda na hayaƙi da aka kunna ya tsaftace ƙasa fiye da nau’in granulated.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, mohuta wa lerole wa khapone ye ekthibeitilwego o hlwekišitše mabu bokaone go feta mohuta wa dithorwana.
Amharic: በጥቅሉ የነቃው ካርቦን የዱቄት አይነት ከሽርክት አይነት ይልቅ አፈሩን በተሻለ መልኩ አጽድቶታል፡፡

English: These researchers were based in a university in Ghana.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano baali bava mu yunivaasite emu mu Ghana.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí wá láti fásitì kan ní Ghana.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bebezinze enyuvesi yaseGhana.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken sun fito ne daga wata jami'a a Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ba be ba hwetšwa go yunibesithi ya Ghana.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራሪዎች የተመሰረቱት በጋና ዩንቨርስቲ ነበር፡፡
